newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Australia's Optus confirms Cousins quits.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Australia's Optus confirms Cousins quits.

text.p: Optus Communications Pty Ltd chief executive officer Zygmunt Switkowski said on Tuesday that Geoffrey Cousins, the former chief executive officer of the Optus Vision affiliate, has quit from his role in the the pay television group.
"He (Cousins) resigned late last week," Switkowski told Reuters, before addressing a luncheon at the Committee for Economic Development of Australia (CEDA).
In September, Cousins announced he would step down from Optus Vision and would take up the company's chairmanship.
Australian newspapers reported on Tuesday that Cousins had quit the pay TV group due to a serious illness in his family.
Switkowski said Optus was interviewing candidates for a chief executive for Optus Vision, but it was unlikely that an announcement would be made until early 1997.
"We are looking worldwide, we are now at the end of November so early in the New Year is a reasonable call," Switkowski said.
Optus Vision is 46.5 percent owned by both Australian telecommunications carrier Optus Communications and Continental CableVision Inc, which has merged with U.S. West.
The balance of Optus Vision is owned by Seven Network Ltd and Kerry Packer's Publishing and Broadcasting Ltd.
